pages.text: Use a Clipboard on your clock to bind it. Use a container in the site: a $(l)Pick-Up$(). $(k:key.sneak) and use one: a $(l)Drop-Off$(). Use two other blocks: the corners of an area.
Use it in the air: choose the job, a filter for each Drop-Off, a name, and $(l)Print$(): one paper becomes a Job Card. Put cards in the Job Rack, or give one to a worker by hand.
Idle staff take the first card they can do with the fewest workers on it: one card, eight workers; eight cards, one each.$(br2)Fields and pens are at most 16 by 16.

$(l)Hauling$(): Pick-Up to Drop-Off$(br)$(l)Sorting$(): one Pick-Up, by filter$(br)$(l)Farming$(): ripe crops, replanted; sheep and cows in a pen$(br)$(l)Security$(): patrols, sees hostiles off the site
pages.title: Form 4-J: Jobs

pages.text: Each kind has its aptitudes: zombies cannot read the labels, cats have one job, fliers fly. Disengaged staff misfile one item in twenty. Nobody tramples, breaks a block or leaves the site.$(br2)$(o)A Job Card is a promise. Staff keep promises. Mostly.$()
